import requests, os, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs('/tmp/w',exist_ok=True)
for pid in ['7XP6','8XQO']:
    open(f'/tmp/w/{pid}.pdb','wb').write(requests.get(f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb',timeout=180).content)
open('/tmp/w/AF.pdb','wb').write(requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P59533-F1-model_v6.pdb',timeout=180).content)
S38=''.join(requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P59533.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(path):
    ch_={};het={}
    for line in open(path):
        rec=line[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM') or line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        if line[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        nm=line[12:16].strip();rn=line[17:20].strip();c=line[21]
        try: ri=int(line[22:26])
        except: continue
        x=np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
        b=float(line[60:66]) if line[60:66].strip() else 0.
        if rec=='ATOM  ' and rn in AA3: ch_.setdefault(c,{}).setdefault(ri,{'rn':rn,'at':{},'b':b})['at'][nm]=x
        elif rn not in ('HOH','WAT'): het.setdefault((c,rn,ri),{})[nm]=x
    return ch_,het
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc
def dp_align(S,gap=-0.6):                      # row-vectorised global DP
    n,m=S.shape; F=np.empty((n+1,m+1)); F[0]=gap*np.arange(m+1); F[:,0]=gap*np.arange(n+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        D=F[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1]; U=F[i-1,1:]+gap
        A=np.empty(m+1); A[0]=F[i-1,0]+gap; A[1:]=np.maximum(D,U)
        B=A-gap*np.arange(m+1); F[i]=gap*np.arange(m+1)+np.maximum.accumulate(B)
    i,j=n,m; pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        d=F[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]; u=F[i-1,j]+gap; l=F[i,j-1]+gap
        if d>=u and d>=l: pr.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif u>=l: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def tmalign(A,Bc,sd):
    L=len(Bc); d0=max(.5,1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8); best=(-1,None,None,None,None)
    for seed in sd:
        pr=list(seed)
        for _ in range(20):
            if len(pr)<6: break
            Rm,tv=kabsch(A[[p[0] for p in pr]],Bc[[p[1] for p in pr]]); At=(Rm@A.T).T+tv
            D=np.linalg.norm(At[:,None,:]-Bc[None,:,:],axis=2); npr=dp_align(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if npr==pr: break
            pr=npr
        if len(pr)<6: continue
        P=A[[p[0] for p in pr]]; Q=Bc[[p[1] for p in pr]]; keep=np.ones(len(pr),bool)
        for _ in range(10):
            Rm,tv=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]); d=np.linalg.norm((Rm@P.T).T+tv-Q,axis=1); nk=d<5.
            if nk.sum()<20 or (nk==keep).all(): break
            keep=nk
        Rm,tv=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]); At=(Rm@A.T).T+tv
        d=np.linalg.norm(At[[p[0] for p in pr]]-Q,axis=1); tm=(1/(1+(d/d0)**2)).sum()/L
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,pr,float(np.sqrt((d[d<5]**2).mean())),Rm,tv)
    return best
def ca_arr(c):
    rs=[r for r in sorted(c) if 'CA' in c[r]['at']]; return rs,np.array([c[r]['at']['CA'] for r in rs])
def sds(nA,nB,k=5):
    return [pr for pr in ([(i,i-o) for i in range(nA) if 0<=i-o<nB] for o in np.linspace(-(nB-40),(nA-40),k).astype(int)) if len(pr)>40]

AF=parse_pdb('/tmp/w/AF.pdb')[0]['A']; plddt={r:AF[r]['b'] for r in AF}
R46=parse_pdb('/tmp/w/7XP6.pdb')[0]['R']; R14=parse_pdb('/tmp/w/8XQO.pdb')[0]['R']
rsAF,CAF=ca_arr(AF)
ORTHO=[71,74,86,92,95,96,99,103,185,189,194,197,198,201,256,260,263,266,270,279,282,283,285,286]
INTRA=[51,53,54,113,117,118,120,216,219,220,240,241,242,244,245,248,249,252,293,297,300,301,302,303,305]
print('='*100); print('I. CONFORMATIONAL STATE: Calpha deviation of the apo TAS2R38 AlphaFold model from the active,')
print('   G-protein-bound cryo-EM templates, after optimal superposition'); print('='*100)
DEV={}
for pid,Rt in [('7XP6',R46),('8XQO',R14)]:
    rst,Ct=ca_arr(Rt); tm,pr,rmsd,Rm,tv=tmalign(CAF,Ct,sds(len(rsAF),len(rst)))
    At=(Rm@CAF.T).T+tv
    dev={rsAF[i]:float(np.linalg.norm(At[i]-Ct[j])) for i,j in pr}
    DEV[pid]=dev
    arr=np.array(list(dev.values()))
    print(f'  {pid}: TM-score {tm:.3f}, {len(pr)} aligned pairs, core RMSD {rmsd:.2f} A')
    print(f'       deviation median {np.median(arr):.2f} A, 75th {np.percentile(arr,75):.2f}, 90th {np.percentile(arr,90):.2f}, max {arr.max():.2f}')
    for lab,rng in [('ICL3 / TM6 cytoplasmic end 232-252',range(232,253)),
                    ('TM3 cytoplasmic end 118-134',range(118,135)),
                    ('orthosteric-site equivalents',ORTHO),
                    ('intracellular cavity lining',INTRA),
                    ('all aligned residues',sorted(dev))]:
        v=[dev[r] for r in rng if r in dev]
        if v: print(f'       mean deviation, {lab:<36} {np.mean(v):5.2f} A (n={len(v)})')
    print('       10 largest deviations:', ', '.join(f'{S38[r-1]}{r}:{d:.1f}' for r,d in sorted(dev.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1])[:10]))
print()
print('  pLDDT: whole model mean %.1f; orthosteric-site equivalents %.1f; intracellular cavity lining %.1f; residues 232-252 %.1f'%(
    np.mean(list(plddt.values())), np.mean([plddt[r] for r in ORTHO if r in plddt]),
    np.mean([plddt[r] for r in INTRA if r in plddt]), np.mean([plddt[r] for r in range(232,253) if r in plddt])))
json.dump({k:{str(a):b for a,b in v.items()} for k,v in DEV.items()},open('/tmp/dev.json','w'))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4.6))
for pid,c in [('7XP6','#9aa0a6'),('8XQO','#4a7fb5')]:
    ks=sorted(DEV[pid]); ax.plot(ks,[DEV[pid][k] for k in ks],color=c,lw=1.1,label=f'vs {pid}')
ax.axvspan(232,252,color='#f2c14e',alpha=.3)
ax.text(233,ax.get_ylim()[1]*.93,'ICL3 / TM6 cytoplasmic end',fontsize=8)
for q,c,m in [(99,'#1f4e79','o'),(103,'#1f4e79','o'),(197,'#1f4e79','o'),(201,'#1f4e79','o'),(264,'#1f4e79','o'),
              (49,'#d62728','D'),(262,'#d62728','D'),(296,'#d62728','D')]:
    if q in DEV['7XP6']:
        ax.scatter(q,DEV['7XP6'][q],color=c,marker=m,s=40,zorder=4)
        ax.annotate(f'{S38[q-1]}{q}',(q,DEV['7XP6'][q]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(3,6),fontsize=8,color=c)
ax.set_xlabel('TAS2R38 residue number'); ax.set_ylabel('Calpha deviation after superposition (A)')
ax.set_title('Apo TAS2R38 AlphaFold model vs active G-protein-bound TAS2R structures:\nthe model matches the templates in the transmembrane core and departs at the cytoplasmic ends',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
